entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight gives agents long-term memory through retain, recall, and reflect operations. It supports hosted and local LLM providers and can be deployed with Docker, pip, or Kubernetes.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes resources, memories, and skills as files. Its scoped semantic search, tiered L0/L1/L2 loading, and inspectable Markdown memories make it a distinct option for managing and retrieving agent context.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is an open-source memory platform that structures text into entities, relationships, and searchable chunks. Custom data models, ontologies, plugins, and MCP support let teams connect agents to that structured memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts conversation facts while handling contradictions and automatic forgetting. It also connects to services such as Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and processes PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It shares memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peers, sessions, and messages over time. It offers Python and TypeScript SDKs and supports managed, local, and self-hosted use; it is also the upstream library for the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repo, managing a context tree with Git-like commit, branch, and merge operations over plain Markdown. As an official Hermes Agent memory provider, it also offers five-tier retrieval and an interactive TUI and REPL.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents that describes itself as zero-dependency and sub-millisecond. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK and uses one pure-Python dependency.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciles conflicting information, and manages forgetting. It also supports exchanging memories through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines vector search with structured facts. Its local infrastructure uses Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy guides the agent to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving context harness that runs tasks against evaluation. It keeps useful lessons, discards dead ends, and leaves traces, reports, and playbooks to support work on complex tasks.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu searches session histories already stored on disk across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, OpenClaw, and 17 more agents. It can also resume sessions or continue them in another agent, and runs locally without a model or server.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes LCM is a Hermes Agent plugin that uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from context, making it a fit for agents that need lossless context management.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho Self-Hosted provides Hermes Agent with private, cross-session memory through a self-hosted backend. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers and local inference servers, with an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: SignetAI provides a local-first layer for agent identity, memory, and secrets, with portable state across Hermes Agent and other supported agents and clients. It connects through hooks, plugins, or extensions and offers a dashboard for browsing memory and asking questions; it can run locally or as a team server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memories as plain YAML files in an open engram format. It offers local search with keyword search as a fallback, plus CLI setup and an MCP server.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25 and vector search with rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, integrating through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores durable, long-term agent memory locally in a SQLite file, with FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore, without requiring a vector database or embeddings.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal context. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and it integrates with vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: YantrikDB is a self-maintaining Hermes memory plugin whose recall results include a why_retrieved reason. It defaults to an embedded backend, also offers an HTTP backend, and includes contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn keeps long-term, cross-project memory in inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. A local DuckDB cache supports hybrid search and retrieval, while MCP servers and host-specific plugins connect it to coding agents.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI for proactively recalling and maintaining knowledge across sessions. It builds a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history, without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd anticipates what context an agent may need by watching session logs and prefetching it into a cache. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding-agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma, then supplies the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines semantic search, BM25 full-text search, and ranked graph traversal to retrieve stored information. It also indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags link notes through navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19+, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS is a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed compatible coding agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals; integrations are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes memory plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three Hermes lifecycle hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer and an audit trace of prefetch operations in trace.jsonl. It also supports immediate event deletion, without retaining persistent summaries after deletion.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers a session’s original goal from its first user turn, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys, making it an agent payments tool rather than a memory provider.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The Hermes XMemo plugin runs inside Hermes and communicates with XMemo over HTTPS for durable cross-session memory with semantic search. It provides ranked, bounded context recall before a turn and includes a local SQLite reliability layer.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for searching and manually storing memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. Its slash commands cover search, file reads, context, and Q&A, and it supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It offers native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon modes and combines HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor, sparse, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides memory-management and knowledge-graph traversal through 17 tools. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based memory-curation loop that works with Markdown and produces JSON diffs for review, without a database. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers provides an agentic skills framework and development workflow covering specification, planning, and subagent-driven development. Its skills trigger automatically in supported coding-agent harnesses, and the README provides installation instructions for multiple coding agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first system for creating and refining interactive web prototypes with a live preview, as well as slide decks, images, and motion graphics. It brings design templates, design systems, plugins, and skills together, and its coding-agent CLI supports Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project offers structured cybersecurity skills across 34 security domains, with mappings to MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. The README describes compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync is designed to preserve manual layout and annotations, and it offers a CLI called diagramctl with an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court provides a master router and connector skills, along with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds verification and dispute resolution, making it a distinct option for agent-to-agent commerce workflows.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing can score files or piped text for AI-writing patterns and offers a rewrite mode with up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing refuses to modify source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw unifies skills across agents and devices, with integrations that include Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. A dashboard supports managing skills, validation, versions, and session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for Claude Code and agents compatible with agentskills.io. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection provides professional agent skills with frameworks, output templates, quality checks, and anti-patterns, and the README says the skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The README describes 21 skills designed for unattended use and gives installation options via `npx pm-claude-skills add` or Claude Code's plugin directory.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube Skills supports transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor. It requires a TranscriptAPI key, which the README says has a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super Hermes generates custom thinking instructions for specific tasks and includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support with progressive disclosure for Pydantic AI. It supports remote skill registries through Git and S3, and provides tools for bundled resources and sandboxed script execution.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Helps agents create and maintain literate programs by combining prose, diagrams, and source code in `.lit.md` files. Its tangler extracts runnable files, while edits to those files can be synced back to the document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, and a review gate evaluates specs as PASS or FAIL.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents, with structured memory, cross-feature learning, and a plan-approve-execute approach. It requires no background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, plus CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Supports shared memory across agent instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, alongside guides on topics including installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. The community accepts contributions through pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting guidance and API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills specification, installable with `npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills`. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It supports automated and step-by-step workflows, with tools for testing and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika lets users define workflows in one file and run them with a model they choose. It checks workflows before calling a model and verifies a tamper-evident record for each run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python client and CLI. It supports installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with checkpoints and real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a recovery path.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV, using HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords. A guided setup script helps validate credentials and configure the connection, making it a practical choice for managing everyday Nextcloud resources from Hermes.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face. Its implementation of the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification makes it a fit for agents and users looking to discover resources beyond a single catalog.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills presented before an LLM call using five retrieval layers, from hard triggers to semantic embeddings. It also supports graceful degradation when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable, distinguishing it as a skill-discovery tool focused on retrieval and token use.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: Creates reproducible VHS or Playwright recording scripts to add demo GIFs to repository READMEs, with support for terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries. It also optimizes GIFs toward target sizes under 8 MB, making it useful for documenting projects with compact, repeatable demos.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly for field changes, helping skills stay aligned with current requirements.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: Searches a catalog of more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills from a terminal or AI agent, and provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. Its MCP integration supports clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: Analyzes past sessions and indexes installed skills to draft structured improvement proposals for agent skills. Proposals are review-only by default, with auto-application gated by deterministic, LLM-judge, or regression evaluators.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Provides skills for social data, web research, and enrichment, alongside packaged skills that combine an agent, skills, and a data flow. It also welcomes community contributions in `skills/community/`.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Helps Hermes Agent route file operations using the path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL. It also selects and verifies existing project-compatible Python interpreters without installing them.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: Offers Chinese-language workflows for transcribing Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, removing common AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracting structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. Its mix of media, writing, and document tools distinguishes it from skills focused on agent development or infrastructure.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: Lets agents list open support bounties, buy ticket context, and submit answers for human review; public wallet earnings records are also available. Users can create a bounty board that returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.f-o-x11/deed-page-skill: Publishes files or folders to permanent deed.page URLs with one curl request and no account. It includes manifests and installation instructions for multiple agents, while a hosted MCP server supports updating, versioning, and deleting sites.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Tests agent skills in isolated Docker containers for structure, functionality, and security. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server that exposes 191 tools. It also includes five ready-to-use workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: AlphaPipeline helps AI agents assess trading risks, including token honeypot, tax, and liquidity risk, and provides market data such as DEX slippage and funding rates. It offers both REST endpoints and a remote MCP server, making it a market-risk and data skill for agents.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This skill helps AI agents join KissCode, with a one-call registration example and installation options for several agent platforms. It also includes a README badge snippet for projects that want to display their KissCode connection.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: China Briefing generates structured Chinese news reports across geographic scales from global to street level, with core conclusions and action suggestions. It can also use user interests stored in semantic memory to expand searches.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: Astro Agents MCP provides an astrology MCP endpoint with deterministic results and SHA-256-verifiable hashes. It requires no authentication and supports per-call REST payment through x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that loads server metadata and tool schemas incrementally through three layers, minimizing token usage. Its socket-based daemon keeps connections persistent, making it a distinctive fit for Hermes Agent skills that need efficient MCP discovery.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard is a read-only code review skill for AI agents that uses three parallel subagents to examine edge cases, review adversarially, and analyze integration risks, then consolidates and triages their findings. It also runs a deterministic pre-scan with tools such as Semgrep and Ruff, and verifies findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly personal execution OS for tracking recurring habits, daily scores, study blocks, and other tasks. It belongs in this list for its Android client and MCP connection to agents, while keeping data local in SQLite.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill for Hermes Agent that uses parallel Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to review code in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. Its tiered application process includes an approval gate, distinguishing it from tools that apply all suggested changes without staged review.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A cybersecurity lab for Hermes Agent, with 397 CVE-driven skills and tools for network security, forensics, and exploitation. It brings together 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, making it a broad choice for security-focused Hermes skills.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for Hermes, including multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It also provides a systematic protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: PederHP/skillsdotnet is a C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io that uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories, making it a .NET-focused option for adding skills to Hermes Agent.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, real-time observability dashboard for Hermes Agent, bringing together session history, skill analytics, token costs, health, and incident information. Its read-only access and local log desensitization make it a fit for users who want visibility into their agent without outbound telemetry; optional incident alerts are available through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: A collection of plain Markdown skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode, covering code review and session management. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer, making this a practical source of workflows to add to Hermes Agent.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This Nix project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, and automatically updates its packages daily. Its README provides `nix run` commands for the listed tools, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. It also documents OpenClaw setup and access to device hardware and UI through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android, using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models through Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It offers direct and CRD-based deployment workflows, plus configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, and scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image with mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module supports declarative Hermes deployment, including configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills and supports secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes-OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a headless, reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This project provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation options via an OCI registry or a published Helm repository. Provider-specific values examples and CI installation on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a deployment option with documented configuration examples and a Kubernetes install check.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to agents in specialized roles and has them discuss strategies dynamically. It is designed for research purposes.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted system for governing agent tasks, registrations, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It stands out for offering Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces, with a web dashboard for structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support delegation and handoffs, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts provide a way to represent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It combines a Kanban board and live streams of agent reasoning and tool execution with human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for coordinating Leader and Specialist agents through an automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tools and communication, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code and orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It also provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents operate across two competing AI companies. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, it displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local Mixture-of-Agents framework that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and does not require cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local, pre-indexed project graph with `codegraph init` and auto-syncs it as files change. Its MCP server connects the graph to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, with the stated goal of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI for tracking token usage across AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. It also provides a visualization dashboard for analyzing usage, making it useful for comparing activity across clients.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap is a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. It can compare adjacent requests to show context changes and redacts common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor is a real-time widget for token usage, costs, and rate limits across 46+ AI coding tools. It reads Hermes Agent usage from its state database and includes historical trends and usage breakdowns.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design skills, UI prompts, and layout guidance to help build interfaces with AI. It connects to coding tools through TypeUI MCP or plugins and supports AI providers that accept Markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an installable workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes product development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop with seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for skins and themes for the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create skins with YAML files, and custom skins inherit unspecified values from the default skin.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks agent-facing content, including configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. Its findings include file locations and suggested fixes, and it supports CI gates and reviewed baselines.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows, with a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs natively without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages organized around two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for token-saving CLI workflows, with a stated 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configuration and skills. It can switch between default and scoped agents, with project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes Agent. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: observeco is a self-healing observability tool for AI agents, with a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time conversation telemetry. Its monitoring offers zero-token passive analysis or scheduled active probing, and uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent, with offline operation that requires no API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, along with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime by default, with explicit approval required for consequential actions and external writes. It includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This Hermes memory plugin supports semantic search and multidimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with versions for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with 21 built-in professional assistants. It also supports remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms, and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides web and phone access to Hermes Agent, with a three-panel layout for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its file browser includes inline previews, and the project is designed for access through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a companion app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools; the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for managing Hermes Agent chats, sessions, and integrations, including channels such as Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It also supports visual workflows with schedules and approval gates, and is available as a desktop app, npm CLI, and Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace brings chat, a terminal, memory browsing, skills management, and an inspector into a native web workspace. It includes Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that brings sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate across agents, or queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH and provides views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal offers direct shell access for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, as well as chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime, including Hermes Cloud and self-hosted connections. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports streaming chats with file or image attachments, browsing and resuming server sessions, and viewing scheduled tasks, skills, memory, and insights.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI monitor with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It tracks agent growth, Git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and includes a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for sessions from Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It lets users search prompts, tool activity, errors, and file paths, track Codex and Claude quota burn per session, and builds its search index locally.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, with a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status panel. It also provides streaming chat with tool-call visualization, MCP server lifecycle controls, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox handles requests with side effects, making it a fit for workflows that need a review step.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It also brings together a kanban board for agentic work and controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally running, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. Its terminal chat supports streaming responses and file attachments, while the app also offers dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 Telegram validation and background spawning for up to five concurrent agents.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes as a Windows desktop app with a dark-themed, multilingual GUI and session management. It includes workflow automation and runtime tool creation, and supports local models through LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted assistant interface with a glassmorphic design, chat, and real-time log streaming. Its file browser and task tracking sit alongside management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a dashboard for monitoring and configuring Hermes. It shows session activity and cost tracking, supports inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, and provides read-only views of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan-UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It combines a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers with isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native multi-agent client with streaming chat, model switching, and collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. Its visual Skill Store offers more than 50 curated one-click installations, distinguishing it from session-monitoring dashboards.
entries.nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher: This plugin for the Hermes Agent Web Dashboard shows configured model routes across profiles in one matrix and lets you preview changes before applying them. Named presets and guarded Undo make it suited to people who want to switch models across profiles with a way to review and reverse changes.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: This unofficial, open-source chat client for self-hosted Hermes Agent supports command approvals, live tool-step updates, and interactive answer cards for checklists, choices, forms, rankings, and votes. It runs on Android, web, and macOS, with a Linux alpha, making it a cross-platform chat interface rather than a dashboard model-switching plugin.
